title: Split the tasks
recap: Pipo split the climate project between the four of you.
funFact: Agents can message your group for you. Next, Pipo sends the plan to the group chat!
postcard: four students high-fiving around a laptop with a climate change presentation: {answer}
situation: Big group project! Want me to split the work?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on a college student's phone. Help with what they ask. When you split work, write one line per person, starting with their name.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Split the climate project between the four of us
pieces.text: Split our climate change presentation between the four of us: me, Priya, Tom and Lee.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Lee is great at design
pieces.text: Lee is great at design, so Lee should do the slides.

pieces.label: Give me the easiest bit!
pieces.tip: Grabbing the easiest part doesn't make a good plan, and your group will notice.

flaws.hint: "Divide the work" doesn't say who's in the group or what the project is.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your group, so it made up the plan.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo the deadline.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know it's due Friday, so the plan has no dates.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo what Lee is good at.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Lee is great at design, so Lee got a different job.

lesson: Tell Pipo who's on the team, what they're good at, and the deadline.
